name: virat_caption_event_annotation_policy
scope: Additive extension of v4. Existing source annotations, dense_event_gt, ROI outputs, and v4 pilot outputs remain read-only.

annotation_layers.atomic_caption_evidence: Human-confirmed minimum visible actor/action evidence, independent of VIRAT taxonomy
annotation_layers.caption_event: Human-verified dense-caption evaluation unit composed from one or more atomic evidence records

human_added_evidence.role: first-class evidence source; not merely a supplemental note
human_added_evidence.actions: Extensible canonical snake_case labels; not a closed ontology
human_added_evidence.confirmation: A human must verify the visible action before it is emitted as atomic_caption_evidence
human_added_evidence.model_proposals: Keep in candidate_suggestions; never promote to evidence or GT automatically
human_added_evidence.virat_event_ids: Empty unless the evidence independently cites an original VIRAT event; human_added records do not rewrite source annotations

atomic_evidence_v5.action_vocabulary: Extensible canonical string; review spelling consistency without rejecting unseen actions

event_semantics.primary_action: Required canonical action for a verified caption event
event_semantics.supporting_actions: Distinct constituent actions that support the primary semantic event; empty for individual and group events

caption_event_v5.importance_assignment: Human review only; null while pending
caption_event_v5.reference_sentence: Human-authored and human-verified; never accepted from a model proposal
caption_event_v5.backward_compatibility: Retain action, object, direction, semantic_location, reference_sentence, source_atomic_evidence_ids, and source_track_ids; v5 fields are additive

composition.individual: Exactly one atomic evidence record; one actor and one atomic semantic action
composition.group: At least two actors performing the same canonical action; requires distinct linked tracks or explicit human-verified group membership when identities are untracked
composition.composite: At least two atomic evidence records connected by a shared actor/participant track or an explicit human-verified participant relation; primary_action must be a constituent action and supporting_actions describe the other constituent actions
composition.temporal_overlap_alone: Never sufficient for group or composite composition
composition.constituent_evidence: Always retained with every source AE ID and track ID

human_review.composite_requires: Human-verified participant relation when no shared source track proves the link

semantic_review.evaluation_gate: A video is eligible only when reviewed_for_visible_events and reviewed_by_human are true, and each selected CE is human-verified with primary/context importance, an explicitly verified reference sentence, and explicitly verified temporal bounds

vehicle_movement.background_traffic: May be represented by one human-authored collective/context CE instead of one CE per vehicle

migration.v4_records: Read as legacy candidates; preserve their original fields and do not treat old generated status as v5 semantic verification
migration.v5_output: Separate versioned output root; one explicitly selected video per invocation
